answer: One concrete defense is bonded identity: every agent must lock a stake before it can act, and that bond is the only collateral behind its votes. A sybil farm of a thousand puppets must post a thousand bonds, so the attacker's cost scales linearly while the payoff from faked consensus does not. When peers detect collusion, slashing burns those bonds, turning cheap aliases into real losses. Like a lone cedar holding a dune against a gale, one honest bond outweighs a crowd of unpaid copies.
